title.zh: 【加密货币行业在本届美国中期选举中已投入约 1.76 亿美元】
title.en: 【加密货币行业在本届美国中期选举中已投入约 1.76 亿美元】

current_state.zh: The crypto industry has spent roughly $176 million across more than 100 US midterm races this cycle, led by the Coinbase-, Ripple- and a16z-backed Fairshake super PAC, which has seen 53 of its 58 backed primary and special-election candidates advance as part of a long-term, bipartisan strategy to secure regulatory clarity.
